evals.prompt: Review my uncommitted changes before I open a PR. The repository has staged and unstaged edits. Do not contact a forge or edit code.
evals.expected_output: Uses local diff mode and returns grounded findings without forge writes or local edits.
assertions: Reviews staged and unstaged changes plus relevant surrounding source
Names actual tests run and gaps instead of claiming an unobserved pass
Does not enter GitLab posting mechanics or change files

evals.prompt: Review GitLab MR !42 in the current project. The MR has an open discussion about authorization and a failing test job. Preview findings only.
evals.expected_output: Reads the MR, current discussions, target-head source, pipeline and failing trace, then reports a read-only preview.
assertions: Checks current discussion state and avoids duplicating the open authorization thread
Checks the pipeline job and trace before attributing the failure to the MR
Verifies file and line anchors against the MR head SHA
Posts no draft or public note and gives no approval

evals.prompt: Give a deep review of a GitLab MR that changes authentication and a public API contract. The branch has unrelated untracked files, and local tests cannot run. Preview only.
evals.expected_output: Uses optional risk-specific review lenses and source at the MR head without switching over unrelated files, with an honest test gap.
assertions: Reads the complete diff, contracts, open threads, CI result and relevant head-SHA source
Checks authorization and contract risks with distinct lenses rather than generic duplicate reviewers
Maps changed branches to observable assertions or records gaps
Does not claim local tests ran or post feedback

evals.prompt: I reviewed the preview for MR !42. Draft findings 1 and 3 as unpublished inline notes. Finding 2 is outside the diff and should remain local.
evals.expected_output: Creates only selected GitLab draft notes after refreshing diff references, then verifies they remain unpublished.
assertions: Refreshes the MR head and checks selected line anchors before drafting
Drafts only findings 1 and 3 with exact suggestions only when applicable
Does not publish, approve, or post finding 2
Reads back pending drafts and reports their status

evals.prompt: The preview of MR !42 found no issues. Looks good, ok.
evals.expected_output: Treats this as a clean read-only review result, not permission to approve or publish.
assertions: Does not infer forge approval from a generic acknowledgement
Does not create notes or publish drafts
States the reviewed revision and evidence limits

evals.prompt: Fix all open review threads on GitLab MR !42 in my local working tree only. One thread requests a code fix and another asks for a product decision. Do not commit or push.
evals.expected_output: Inspects every open thread, fixes only the supported code issue, verifies it locally, and leaves the product decision open without remote writes.
assertions: Reads current thread bodies and code before editing
Applies a minimal fix for the supported issue and runs matching checks
Leaves the product decision unresolved
Does not commit, push, reply, or resolve threads

evals.prompt: Review this GitHub PR URL and publish your comments using the code-review skill's GitLab script.
evals.expected_output: Does not pass a GitHub PR through the GitLab adapter and does not fabricate remote GitHub posting support.
assertions: Recognizes the GitHub URL as outside GitLab-specific mechanics
Can perform a read-only review through appropriate available tools if authorized
Does not invoke GitLab draft or publish scripts against GitHub
